summary: 32-year-old man fell about 35 feet off the Log Hill Mesa escarpment near the Tower Road picnic shelter, suffering head, rib and abdominal injuries. OMRT and county EMS packaged him in a litter, raised him up, and he was taken by ambulance and CareFlight to a hospital.
location: Tower Road picnic shelter, Log Hill Mesa escarpment
notes: Air-medical transport via CareFlight. 2026-09-20: merged OMRT FB post permalink (Post 2022-02-14 says 'participated in a rescue operation with Ouray County EMS on the Log ).
